description: Election Commission - Declare  that  Mr. Kanthaiya Tharkku, Mr. Jayakumar Nitharsan,  Mr. Ramanathan Yogeswarn,  Mr. Sivakumaran Gajey as Member of the Chavakachcheri P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government body (Chavakachcheri Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including declarations of selected members to fill positions vacated by resignations, which falls under election-related matters and procedures.
